butter_paneer.name: Butter Paneer
instructions: Cut paneer into bite-size cubes. Finely chop the onion and tomato.
Heat butter in a pan over medium heat. Sauté onion until soft, then add tomato and cook until pulpy.
Add ginger-garlic paste and garam masala. Cook for 1 minute, then blend or mash the mixture until smooth.
Return the sauce to the pan, add a splash of water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add paneer and a little cream if desired. Simmer gently for 4–5 minutes without overcooking the paneer.
Season with salt and serve hot with naan or rice.

french_toast.name: French Toast
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar and a pinch of cinnamon in a shallow bowl.
Dip each bread slice into the mixture for a few seconds on each side; do not soak until soggy.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Cook the bread for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve warm with fruit, honey or maple syrup.

chocolate_cake.name: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Grease and line a round cake tin.
Whisk flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking powder and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Add eggs, milk, melted butter and vanilla. Mix just until the batter is smooth.
Pour into the prepared tin and bake for about 30–35 minutes, or until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack and cool completely before slicing.

strawberry_pancake.name: Strawberry Pancake
instructions: Whisk flour, milk and egg into a smooth, pourable batter. Rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat. Pour a small ladle of batter and spread gently.
Cook until bubbles form and the edges look set, then flip and cook the other side until golden.
Repeat with the remaining batter.
Top with sliced strawberries and serve warm with yogurt, honey or syrup.

chicken_curry.name: Chicken Curry
instructions: Cut chicken into medium pieces and season lightly with salt.
Heat oil in a deep pan. Sauté chopped onion until golden, then add ginger-garlic paste.
Add chopped tomato and cook until soft. Stir in turmeric, cumin, coriander and chili powder.
Add chicken and cook over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring to coat well.
Add water, cover and simmer for 20–25 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce thickens.
Adjust salt and garnish with fresh coriander before serving.

beef_steak.name: Beef Steak
instructions: Pat the steak dry and season both sides generously with salt and black pepper. Rest for 15–20 minutes.
Heat a heavy skillet until very hot. Add olive oil and place the steak in the pan.
Sear for 2–4 minutes per side depending on thickness and desired doneness.
Add crushed garlic and a little butter during the final minute, spooning the butter over the steak.
Transfer to a plate and rest for 5–10 minutes before slicing against the grain.

chicken_biryani.name: Chicken Biryani
instructions: Rinse basmati rice until the water runs mostly clear, then soak for 20 minutes.
Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, salt and biryani spices for at least 20 minutes.
Parboil rice in salted water until about 70% cooked; drain immediately.
Fry sliced onions until golden. Add marinated chicken and cook until the outside changes color and the masala becomes fragrant.
Layer the chicken with the parboiled rice. Add fried onions, coriander and a little saffron water if available.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat for 20–25 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, then gently fluff and serve.

vegetable_fried_rice.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Cook rice ahead of time and chill it so the grains stay separate.
Heat a wok or large pan over high heat and add oil.
Stir-fry carrot and bell pepper for 2–3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add cold rice and toss continuously. Season with soy sauce, pepper and a little salt if needed.
Cook for 3–4 minutes until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Serve immediately.

grilled_vegetable_salad.name: Grilled Vegetable Salad
instructions: Slice the vegetables into even pieces and pat them dry.
Toss vegetables with a little olive oil, salt and black pepper.
Grill on a hot pan or grill until lightly charred and tender but still crisp.
Cool for a few minutes, then arrange over lettuce.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil and a pinch of salt just before serving.

vegetable_stir_fry.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Cut broccoli and bell pepper into similar-sized pieces so they cook evenly.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add broccoli first and stir-fry for 2 minutes, then add bell pepper.
Cook for another 3–4 minutes until bright and crisp-tender.
Season with soy sauce, garlic and black pepper. Toss for 30 seconds and serve hot.

banana_oatmeal.name: Banana Oatmeal
instructions: Add oats and milk to a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the oats become creamy.
Mash half of the banana and stir it into the oatmeal.
Transfer to a bowl and top with the remaining banana slices and honey.
Serve warm.

avocado_toast.name: Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast the bread until crisp and golden.
Cut the avocado, remove the pit and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash with a fork, adding a pinch of salt and chili flakes.
Spread the avocado over the toast and drizzle with olive oil.
Serve immediately with lemon juice if desired.

omelette.name: Vegetable Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and black pepper until well combined.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil or butter.
Sauté chopped onion, bell pepper and tomato for 2–3 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook without stirring until the edges set.
Fold the omelette in half and cook for another minute until fully set.
Serve hot.

cheesecake.name: Classic Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°C (320°F). Line the base of a springform tin.
Mix biscuit crumbs with melted butter and press firmly into the base.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then mix in eggs one at a time.
Pour the filling over the crust and bake for about 40–45 minutes until the center is just set.
Turn off the oven, leave the cheesecake inside for 15 minutes, then cool completely.
Chill for at least 4 hours before slicing.

tiramisu.name: Classic Tiramisu
instructions: Brew strong coffee and let it cool completely.
Whip cream until soft peaks form, then gently fold in mascarpone and sugar.
Dip each ladyfinger briefly into the cooled coffee; do not oversoak.
Arrange a layer of soaked biscuits in a dish and spread over half the mascarpone mixture.
Repeat the layers and dust the top generously with cocoa powder.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours before serving.

chocolate_chip_cookies.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a baking tray.
Cream softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla, then mix in the flour until just combined.
Fold in chocolate chips without overmixing.
Scoop dough onto the tray with space between each cookie.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until the edges are golden. Cool for 5 minutes before transferring.

grilled_salmon.name: Grilled Salmon
instructions: Pat the salmon fillets dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Mix olive oil, minced garlic and lemon juice, then brush over the salmon.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill skin-side down for 4–5 minutes, then carefully turn and cook another 3–4 minutes.
Cook until the center flakes easily and reaches a safe internal temperature.
Rest for 2 minutes and serve with lemon wedges.

creamy_garlic_pasta.name: Creamy Garlic Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Melt butter or heat olive oil in a pan and gently sauté minced garlic for 30–60 seconds.
Add cream and simmer gently for 2–3 minutes.
Stir in parmesan until melted. Add a splash of pasta water if the sauce is too thick.
Toss in the cooked pasta and coat evenly.
Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

chicken_tacos.name: Chicken Tacos
instructions: Slice chicken into thin strips and season with cumin, paprika, garlic, salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet with a little oil and cook chicken over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20–30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with chicken, tomato salsa and sliced avocado.
Add lime juice or fresh coriander if desired.
Serve immediately while warm.

grilled_chicken_wrap.name: Grilled Chicken Wrap
instructions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, paprika and a little oil.
Grill or pan-cook the chicken for 5–7 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until fully cooked.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, then slice thinly.
Warm the tortillas and layer with lettuce, tomato and chicken.
Add yogurt or a light garlic sauce if desired.
Roll tightly, slice in half and serve.

caesar_salad.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper, then grill until cooked through.
Rest the chicken for a few minutes and slice.
Wash and dry the lettuce thoroughly, then chop into bite-size pieces.
Toss lettuce with Caesar dressing until lightly coated.
Add sliced chicken and parmesan, then toss gently.
Serve immediately with croutons if available.

tomato_soup.name: Creamy Tomato Soup
instructions: Roughly chop tomatoes and onion.
Sauté onion in a little oil until translucent, then add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, salt and enough water to cover. Simmer for 15–20 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth, taking care with the hot liquid.
Return to the pan, stir in cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Adjust seasoning and serve hot with toasted bread.

roasted_vegetables.name: Roasted Mediterranean Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Cut zucchini, broccoli and tomatoes into even pieces.
Toss vegetables with olive oil, salt, pepper and dried herbs.
Spread in a single layer on a baking tray so they roast instead of steam.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, turning once halfway through.
Serve hot as a side dish or light meal.

spinach_chickpea_salad.name: Spinach Chickpea Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach thoroughly.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Chop cucumber into bite-size pieces.
Combine spinach, chickpeas and cucumber in a large bowl.
Whisk lemon juice with olive oil, salt and pepper, then drizzle over the salad.
Toss gently and serve immediately.

stuffed_bell_peppers.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Cut the tops off the bell peppers and remove the seeds.
Sauté chopped onion and tomato until soft.
Mix the vegetables with cooked rice, salt, pepper and your preferred herbs.
Fill each pepper loosely with the rice mixture and place upright in a baking dish.
Add a small splash of water to the dish, cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove foil and bake for another 10–15 minutes until the peppers are tender.
